Workflow.Name: PayPlus - Import Banks & Branches
Workflow.Description: Imports Israeli banks and branches from data.gov.il (resource 2202bada-4baf-45f5-aa61-8c5bad9646d3) into alex_bank / alex_bankbranch, linking each branch to its bank. Triggered by alex_bank_import_enabled on the config row; upsert by bank code / branch code; writes back import status.
